name: Banner
description: Astryx Banner — a status surface with title, description and optional dismiss. Promoted from the Phase-A code extraction of @astryxdesign/core@0.1.6 (MIT, react-tsx adapter, src/Banner/Banner.tsx, extracted 2026-07-20 — see examples/astryx/PROVENANCE.md). status/container/isDismissable are verbatim; title and description are materialized text slots (Astryx types both as ReactNode). CODE-SIDE fidelity: structural truth + StyleX token bindings, not the computed pixel floor (Astryx Phase A-2).

props.name: status
props.description: Status type controlling the icon and color scheme.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Whether the banner can be dismissed.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text displayed prominently in the header area.
props.default: A new software update is available.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text below the title in the header area.
props.default: See what changed in this version.
